title: Session parameters that change results
description: Of the 163 session parameters, these change what a query returns: `TIMEZONE` (`TIMESTAMP_LTZ`), `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` (what `TIMESTAMP` means), `WEEK_START` and `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` (`DAYOFWEEK`, `WEEK`, `DATE_TRUNC('WEEK')`), `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING`, `TIMESTAMP_DAY_IS_ALWAYS_24H`, the `*_OUTPUT_FORMAT` and `*_INPUT_FORMAT` parameters (text casts), `TWO_DIGIT_CENTURY_START`, `QUOTED_IDENTIFIERS_IGNORE_CASE`, and `USE_CACHED_RESULT`, which returns a stored result for the same text (a double sum then does not vary). Their values at the probes are in the header of probes.json.
Collations come from `COLLATE` or `DEFAULT_DDL_COLLATION` on a table.
reference: No setting changes the reference. sverify's SQL pins what it depends on in the text: `TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6)`, ISO week functions, explicit `NULLS FIRST`/`LAST`, quoted identifiers, and no text casts but of integers.

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: ALTER SESSION SET DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING = 'FIRST'; SELECT x FROM (VALUES (1), (NULL), (2)) AS s(x) ORDER BY x

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
